oracle.call_forth_oracle_signature: Call Forth the Tempest deals damage to each creature your opponents control equal to the total mana value of other spells you've cast this turn.

physical_fixture.zone_policy: Each cascade exiles a physical top-card sequence; only lower-MV nonlands can be cast; skipped lands bottomed and physically conserved. Abaddon exists in command-zone separate from the 99. All three cascade abilities are independent simultaneous triggers ordered by controller; each free hit resolves before the next cascade trigger.

cases.expected: Loyal Subordinate 3 each opponent before second main => X9 at hand cast, 2 printed plus 1 granted, three physical free casts MV1/2/2 => 5 damage to each opposing creature; three Lost tokens; one skipped physical Swamp returns to library bottom.

Preexisting Keeper (6) + Kessig Flamebreather (1) attack unblocked => X7; only two printed cascades at Call cast. Keeper trigger after Sol Ring resolves can raise X to 8, but no third cascade is retroactively added.
Preexisting Keeper (6) + Storm-Kiln Artist (2) attack unblocked => X8 at Call cast, three cascades. Physical source-paid MV8.
No opponent lost life this turn => Abaddon does not grant; printed double cascade still occurs, damage3 across two actual free casts.
Abaddon granted at X9; three cascade abilities exile and bottom cards, but Drannith prevents any nonhand free cast; no Lost tokens or contribution from hits.
Call hand cast consumes Rule of Law's one spell; printed and granted cascade exiles cards yet cannot cast hits; source spell still deals zero to opponent creatures if no previous spell this turn.
Opponent counters the Call source spell before cascades resolve; pending three abilities still cascade-cast hits, but Call itself never resolves/deals creature damage.
Prior physically sourced and cast Boltwave MV1 caused 9 life loss; 3 actual physical cascade hits add 1+2+2; Call deals 6 damage to each opposing creature. Pure copy of spell (not cast) excluded.

limitations: Prearranged physical 8-land paid cast is a conditional setup, not an observed draw/access rate.
Opponent life-loss combat sources are staged from real deck creatures; blocked/unblocked attacks are explicit assumptions; no opponent likelihood inferred.
Cascade hits are set atop the exact physical library for effect sequencing, not random hit frequency.
No full 99-card Magic game simulation or winner determination.
No M6.6 certification while P0-022 and P0-023 remain required.
